quotes.text: Malicious actors are using increasingly advanced AI, powered by more data, increasingly accessible computing resources, and advancements in machine learning algorithms. Our own prudent use of AI can help us more effectively and efficiently accomplish our mission to secure the homeland.

As we look at this how do you see the role of Government as AI develops and what do we need to do to ensure the public that that development does not allow our adversaries to become even more our enemy than what it is?
